subject: general
question: The Champaran Mela is celebrated every year in which city of Chhattisgarh?
solution:
The correct answer is** __Raipur.__**** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Champaran Mela **is a fair that is celebrated every year** in Chhattisgarh.**
 
• The festivals of Chhattisgarh are** reflective of the ethnic and rustic culture of the local people of Chhatttisgarh, **mainly of the tribal communities
 
• Champaran Mela is part of the festivals celebrated in the** Raipur**. 
 
• Raipur is the state **capital of Chhattisgarh** and it is located almost in the center of the state.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Champaran Mela i**s actually a fair that is organized at a place called **Champaran.**
 
• This annual fair has obtained its name from the place where it is celebrated. Champaran is situated at a distance of 56 km from the state capital of Chhattisgarh
 
• The fair at Champaran is held on the** month of Magh,** that is from the January to February.
 
• This cultural fair of Champaran is very popular. Mainly the followers of **Vaishnav religion **visit the Champaran Mela.
